assumptions: The support function is MONOTONE. Step (1) uses it directly; EMB-MONOTONE-HYP is an open hypothesis whose falsifier is interference, and scripts/emb-support.mjs refuses to compute kernels for a capability whose observations falsify it.

STILL OPEN: whether the antecedent f(∅)=1 ever holds of a real capability. This artifact runs no model, so f_c(∅) has been measured for nothing — DEF-R7-PRIORS-UNMEASURED. The claim is an implication and asserts no instance.

`revocation` means removal of artifacts from the support universe. Revocation by other means — retraction of authority, refusal at an invocation gate — is a different operation and is untouched by this result.
attrs.evidence: Two steps. (1) Monotonicity carries f(∅)=1 to every superset, so every set is sufficient and the unique minimal sufficient set — the unique prime implicant — is ∅. The kernel family is {∅}. (2) A minimal revocation cut is a minimal transversal of the kernel family: a set meeting every kernel. No set meets ∅, since ∅ has no elements to meet. So no transversal exists and the cut family is empty. The consequence is not that revocation is expensive; it is that revocation by artifact deletion is not defined. scripts/emb-battery-control.mjs §2 computes both families over the declared universe and carries the POSITIVE CONTROL that makes the result mean something: CAP-SYNTHETIC-AOBC, where f(∅)=0, yields cuts {A,B} and {A,C} through the same code path. An engine returning `no cuts` for everything would produce the empty family and fail the control.
attrs.implementation_binding: scripts/emb-battery-control.mjs — analyse(), against CAP-SYNTHETIC-IN-PRIORS and CAP-SYNTHETIC-AOBC
attrs.prior_art: Ordinary monotone Boolean algebra; the kernel/cut duality is the minimal-cut-set structure of coherent fault trees, property-tested rather than cited in scripts/emb-support.mjs §3.
attrs.review_focus: The proof is two lines and the interesting question is whether the ANTECEDENT ever holds. That is DEF-R7-PRIORS-UNMEASURED and it is open: this artifact runs no model, so f_c(∅) has been measured for nothing. The claim is an implication and asserts no instance.
attrs.statement: For every monotone capability-support function f with f(∅) = 1, the family of minimal revocation cuts is empty: no set of artifacts, including the whole universe, is a revocation.
